_v1_notes.CROSSING MODE|SUBJECT: a returning foreign fighter concealed in a commercial vehicle is N - the profile is a purposeful traveller with means, not one relying on a haulier. A sanctioned individual on foot across a green border is N: designation implies resources and a route that avoids exertion and exposure. A trafficked person on false documents is N: traffickers move victims by concealment, not by presenting them to biometric checks.
_v1_notes.CROSSING MODE|DETECTION CAPABILITY: each mode is visible to exactly one or two capabilities. Vehicle concealment is caught by scanning only - no documents are presented, no green-border sensors involved, no manifest. Foot crossing is caught by ground sensors only. False documents at a checkpoint are caught by document checks and advance data. Small boats are caught by patrol coverage only.
_v1_notes.SUBJECT|DETECTION CAPABILITY: a sanctioned individual and a returning fighter are both N for vehicle scanning: neither travels concealed in freight, as above.
_v1_notes.SUBJECT|DISPOSITION: an economic migrant is N for protection referral, having no claim by definition. A trafficked person is N for refusal and return - protection obligations attach. A sanctioned individual is N for admission with monitoring and N for protection referral. A returning fighter is N for refusal and return (own nationals cannot be refused) and N for protection referral.
_v1_notes.DETECTION CAPABILITY|DISPOSITION: no detection capability excludes any disposition.
